pages.text: Hit a Bowlder once with a pickaxe.

pages.title: Bring a Pickaxe
pages.text: Develop your chosen fighting style and prepare for the next encounter.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Prepare protection and find a Bowlder. Hold the pickaxe during the hit; positive damage is required.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Bowlder follows the native Wither milestone. A pickaxe addresses its special defense, arrows are ineffective, and Armor Crumbling matters.
